text.text_excerpt: I loved checking out the Peacock room! The ambiance is awesome; very elegant and chic. This is a really good place for appetizers and drinks. (I don't think they have happy hour deals, so I wish they did). I got an Aperol Spritz ($12) and loved it! Our waiter was very attentive and kind. I would keep in mind that they only have 4 entreé options, so if you're coming here for dinner, I would keep that in mind. The Peacock Burger was very good and a decent size for a full meal! I do wish the Pimento Cheese and Tuna Crudo came with more bread/crackers.

Great experience at the Peacock room both times I've went. The cocktails are spectacular and the service has been amazing. I mean you come from the cocktails but you stay for the vibes. One night we enjoyed live music and another night there was glitter and photographers. It was a fun time. The room reminds me of some mysterious place because you walk into the hotel and its kind of bland. Then you pop into this blue room with accents of gold and beauty. The Flock to Me was my fave cocktail. I like the oysters app and the burger was pretty delish to me. I love the fries but I haven't met a fry I did not like.

My husband and I made a reservation here a few nights ago and stopped in. Super cute chic peacock vibes-5 starts for atmosphere! Service was a bit slow, and we were disappointed to find out after our server finally came over that the kitchen had just closed (unfortunately the hostess who sat us didn't tell us that or else we might have just left and tried to come back another time). We did get a few drinks though and they were both quite tasty! I got the sherry cobbler (legit tasted like a liquified blackberry cobbler-delish!) and my husband got a whiskey sour which he really enjoyed. We will have to come back to try the food-menu sounded yummy.
